statements.statement: Electrons are found inside the nucleus of an atom.
statements.explanation: Electrons orbit outside the nucleus. It is protons and neutrons that are packed inside the nucleus.

statements.statement: Atoms are the building blocks that make up all physical matter you can touch or stand on.
statements.explanation: Everything around us (solids, liquids, and gases) is composed of atoms, even though they are far too small to see with the naked eye.

statements.statement: The nucleus of an atom contains protons and neutrons.
statements.explanation: The nucleus is the dense center of an atom and is packed with two types of particles: protons (positively charged) and neutrons (no charge).
